items.observation: Featured cards lacked source attribution and explicit cut-off in the same view.
items.proposed_fix: bounded cards with source, cut-off, state and limits

items.observation: Public status projection was implicit across heterogeneous case records.
items.proposed_fix: shared presentation projection without changing canonical evidence records

items.observation: Correction and restriction states were not governed by one publication policy.
items.proposed_fix: correction/publication policy and safe restricted projection

items.observation: Source-rights basis was not consistently explicit.
items.proposed_fix: rights metadata policy; unknown remains unknown

items.observation: Commercial privacy notice was too brief for actual intake fields.
items.proposed_fix: expanded aligned notices and minimization copy

items.observation: Confidentiality acknowledgement was not separated from notice acknowledgement.
items.proposed_fix: separate required, unselected acknowledgements; no publication or marketing consent

items.observation: Submission event notes could contain customer narrative.
items.proposed_fix: separate private context and minimal append-only event note
items.validation: synthetic D1 tests; production migration not applied

items.observation: Retention, backup, email and AI processor facts are not fully verified.
items.proposed_fix: operator fact collection before final notice/deploy

items.observation: Terms tied correction of a superseded state to purchase of a later cycle.
items.proposed_fix: service error correction independent of new research; new sources/cut-off may be separately scoped

items.observation: Operator identity statements are website assertions without recorded credential review status.
items.proposed_fix: central facts file with verification status

items.observation: Case sponsorship, commissioning, relationship and source-dependency disclosure lacked a common structure.
items.proposed_fix: structured disclosure with NOT_REVIEWED rather than invented none

items.observation: Audit recommendations may conflict with frozen product decisions or require legal judgment.
items.proposed_fix: controlled release plan and counsel gate; no production deployment
